اخرمصصت (form IVq)
# اِخْرَمْصَصْتُ (iḵramṣaṣtu) /ix.ram.sˤasˤ.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِخْرَمَصَّ (iḵramaṣṣa)
# اِخْرَمْصَصْتَ (iḵramṣaṣta) /ix.ram.sˤasˤ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِخْرَمَصَّ (iḵramaṣṣa)
# اِخْرَمْصَصْتِ (iḵramṣaṣti) /ix.ram.sˤasˤ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِخْرَمَصَّ (iḵramaṣṣa)
